result.title: Multiple Criteria Decision Making Under XORness
result.summary: How should we make decisions under XORness? XORness is a class of uncertainty arising from indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy. We develop a multiple criteria decision making framework that preserves XORness throughout the decision process. We define XOR numbers and prove their fundamental arithmetic and algebraic properties. Building on these results, we extend the deterministic decision matrix to an XOR decision matrix and introduce a compatible normalization procedure. Further, we propose an additive XOR aggregation operator, which preserves indeterminacy, exclusivity, and hesitancy inherent in evaluations. In addition, we introduce an axiomatic XORness measure that quantifies the degree of uncertainty associated with global performance scores and develop a performance--XORness index to rank alternatives. We prove that this index induces a total preorder over the set of alternatives and identify the conditions for preserving dominance. The applicability of the developed framework is demonstrated through the risk assessment of cyberthreat scenarios in energy systems, and recommendations are derived using the XOR--weighted sum method.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向 XORness 不确定性的多准则决策框架，定义 XOR 数、XOR 决策矩阵与加性聚合算子，并给出 XORness 测度与排序指数，应用于能源系统网络威胁风险评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 属运筹学多准则决策研究，关注评价聚合与备选方案排序，不涉及视觉或多模态推理中的内部状态表示、证据获取或 STOP 决策，也未提供可核查的迁移线索。
